allocation.question: Can Product land the audited parameterized-inheritance capability as the shipped carrier in src/spider/ (replacing the literal, below-threshold distill_parameterized path), evidenced by a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate that includes (i) a known-positive inherited-parameter round trip on a real task, (ii) a known-negative refusal case, (iii) an explicit treatment-vs-comparator contrast showing the shipped-kernel treatment differs from the INSTRUCTIONS baseline, (iv) shipped-kernel identity and tests, and (v) promotion-pinned accounting - while explicitly NOT running the four-arm benchmark?
allocation.rationale: This is critical-path readiness condition B1: the shipped Product treatment must demonstrate a pre-freeze executable inherited parameterized mechanism plus a known-negative refusal. The active mandate already supersedes the parent's four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark proposal, which the audit forbids funding until B1/B2/B3 hold, so the scientifically correct move is to remove the B1 blocker here rather than buy the expensive benchmark. The mandate is self-contained (identity, tests, treatment-vs-INSTRUCTIONS contrast, accounting) and does not require the unsatisfiable REST dynamic-range certificate that caused the eight prior product failures. Continue with disposition SUPERSEDE; no Product Core promotion without a verdict authorizing it.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: 435 canonical experiments. Five of six lanes carry prefreeze work; physics is IDLE with no mandate. The cumulative audit and the machine snapshot agree on one strategic bottleneck: the flagship inheritance question (C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON) is gated by three readiness conditions - B1 a shipped parameterized-inheritance carrier plus a known-negative refusal (Product/C-PARAM-INHERIT), B2 a task bank with non-ceiling cold/retrieval dynamic range and a real treatment/comparator contrast (Runtime/C-MEAS-VALID), B3 a same-model credential-free endpoint able to drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent test (Intel/C-LLM-INHERIT). Until all three hold, expensive full-benchmark execution is not funded. This cycle therefore endorses the already-mounted blocker-removal mandates for Product (B1) and Runtime (B2), keeps Intel on the cheap, decisive capability-ceiling test (B3), and does not launch the four-arm benchmark. Graph and Frontier keep their prefreeze threads only because each is now a single decisive gate with an explicit PARK branch (construct a >=2-anchor D1V population or park the four-anchor route; certify a DEEP sampling frame pre-freeze or park the discovery question), which is the audit's recommended way to stop two local attractors rather than feed them. The idle physics lane is reactivated on a materially re-scoped object - endpoint access-barrier state persistence/timescale and static-denylist validity horizon - with a hard pre-freeze attainability certificate, a two-sided falsifier, a calibrated memory/constant null and a capped budget; if the certificate cannot be satisfied the lane must PARK rather than spend an EXECUTE cycle. No claim status is upgraded by this allocation; no frozen transaction is disturbed; measurement-invalid and negative evidence is preserved as-is.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout ran DEGRADED (model unavailable, rc=124). Its scout_brief.json is a fallback generated from the director snapshot: candidate directions were derived from the existing active mandates, with empty agent_priors, spider_evidence, external_directional_context and cross_lane_dependencies, and only three generic questions for the director. It therefore supplied no external reconnaissance or new evidence and did not change any direction decision. Its frontier and physics candidates were re-derived independently from the snapshot and Codex and are retained on their own merits (not because Scout proposed them); I did not treat the Scout's first frontier/physics candidates as authoritative or as evidence. Because no external landscape signal was available, this cycle deliberately spends no budget on competitor/dataset novelty and keeps each lane on a decision-relevant, substrate-ready question.
